about: Andrei's inputs to Agent OS (messages in the thread and comments on the page), from 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-29. Kept inputs have their own words and metadata: topic, status (done, partly, open, rule) and result. Inputs that say the same thing are merged. Chatter and inputs about parts that work in a different way now are removed (only their ids stay). knowledge is the useful summary of all inputs, by topic.

status.partly: a part works, a part is in open-ideas
status.rule: a rule for how to work

knowledge.summary: Do only what Andrei asks. Do not add fields, buttons or text that Andrei did not ask for. When a new field is necessary, name it and tell why before you add it. Print the file tree of the workspace in each report. Test the page before you report. Write the docs in ASD-STE100. Ask before you merge into main.

The page is one JSON state: agents (the files of the agent), network, environment and extension (views, functions, data, apps). The page renders only from the state. Each view keeps all the data that it shows in its ui-data. A file, a folder and a function can have metadata in the state, and can have their own views.

knowledge.topic: Every call is tracked and tested
knowledge.summary: Each function has input, output, imports, tests, expected-state-change, docs, pseudo, performance, code and calls. The code looks as it does in a code file, with its import lines and signature. After each run the runtime writes output, errors and performance. A function that changes nothing has an empty expected-state-change.

Each save is a new version (commit) in the page database. The arrows go through the versions. Only changes shows added (green), updated (yellow) and deleted (red). A Claude Code session commits, pushes and saves a new version; an open page runs it at once and the timeline shows a New version block with how each part worked before and now.

knowledge.topic: One state view, tabs are representations
knowledge.summary: The state view is the main view for the state and its changes. Full State is the whole JSON. Each other tab (Files, Views, Functions, Network, Environment, Performance, Improvements, Flow, Video, Docs, Agent Run) is a filter or a view of the same state. With Only changes, each tab shows only what the chosen block changed or touched, and a tab with no change hides.

The timeline shows what happened since the page opened, as blocks: the last AI run notification, network, index.html, the state load, then each call. You can replay it, restart it, play saved flows, and show only AI runs or only UI blocks. A click on a block shows it in the state view.

Buttons are icons with a title. Times show as time ago. A long text shows as "...": the pointer shows a preview in the colors of its kind, a click opens it. Code is formatted and colored. md files read as a page, with themes (Reader, White, Black, Sepia, Night, Mono) that each have their own change colors. Each file kind has its own viewer.

From the top: the timeline (when open), the header, one main view, the footer with the record button. Only one main view (docs, state, notes) is open at a time, and each has a close button. A view uses only the space between the header and the footer. The Device button shows all views at mobile, tablet or desktop width.

The record button records audio (one click) or opens a menu (two clicks): audio, video, notes. Keys: Arrow Up two times, or Arrow Up and Arrow Down. While it records you can select elements; their paths go into the note. A 4 second hold opens Notes. Notes have browser transcription, text notes and Send to Claude. On claude.ai the frame blocks the microphone.

network and environment are parts of the state that the runtime fills from code: each request (with used_for and expected), browser data (also the claude.ai database), listeners, timers, observers, connections, devices and permissions. Environment has a Browser and a Server side. Libraries load from the files of the repo, not from a CDN, and not minified.

knowledge.topic: The files are the files of main
knowledge.summary: agents.agent-oss.files always holds the files of main (all files of the repo except state.json). The Files tab shows all of them as a tree.

Each agent run that changes files gets a run file (runs/<session>-<run>.json): steps, lanes of the main agent and subagents, uses of MCP, skills and workflows, files read and changed, and why. The timeline shows it as an AI run notification block with Index, Details and Steps.

The repo (andyvauliln/agents-os, branch agent-os) has everything to start the agent and the page on another server: clone it, run python3 -m http.server in the folder and open the page. Without claude.ai there is no database: saves stay only until reload.

The Claude app can keep an old copy of the page: reload it to see the newest version. claude.ai blocks stylesheets from a CDN, so styles are inline. Page comments reach Claude only with Send to Claude. The artifact frame on claude.ai cannot use the microphone.

Not done yet: the Slide brand header with connections (apps, agent, MCP, storage), model chip, notifications, apps and theme buttons (m00); extension data, common_app_storage and apps; the Improvements and Video tabs; network of the server, the agent and MCP; memory and cost in Performance; the Functions tree split into agent and extension with local and public marks; Views tabs html, data, functions, state and requests; views for each file kind and folder from metadata; an interactive Page tab.
